name: Unit Gesture
summary: Reports discrete hand gestures without touching the device.

host_bindings.notes: External bus; do not reinitialize internal I2C on GPIO12/11.
USB-powered bring-up: enable EXT_5V output after M5.begin when powering the unit from StickS3. Do not feed external power into an output-enabled Grove port.

support.meaning: Manufacturer documentation and source review only. No accessory driver or emulator input is implemented by this record.

first_hardware_check: Check 0x73 on the external bus; initialize the vendor PAJ7620U2 driver.
Display raw gesture names first; try left/right and wave; only then map events to app actions.
troubleshooting: Confirm sensor-facing orientation before deciding that left/right is reversed.
Debounce repeated detections and keep driver polling bounded so the device controls keep working.
This is an external gesture sensor, not the board IMU or touchscreen swipe input.

app_fixture_plan.note: Keep named synthetic gestures in the app test harness; do not map them silently onto the emulator shake control.

libraries.name: M5Stack PAJ7620U2 example
libraries.author: M5Stack and embedded driver authors
libraries.purpose: Reference initialization and gesture decoding; review included source licenses before adaptation.
